test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 08 Sept, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Parts of the following sentence have been given as options. Select the option that contains an error.

I shall be playing for four hours.
solution:
The correct answer is '**shall be playing**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error in the sentence is the use of "**shall be**" in place of "**will be**."
 
• In modern usage, "**will**" is more commonly used than "**shall**".
 
• The correct phrase should be "**I will be playing for four hours**."

Therefore, the correct answer is ‘**Option 3**’

 

**Correct Sentence:** *I will be playing for four hours.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **four hours**: This part of the sentence is correct. It appropriately specifies the duration.
 
• **I**: This part of the sentence is correct. It is the subject pronoun.
 
• **for**: This part of the sentence is correct. It is the correct preposition to indicate duration.
